purpose: Explain existing n=5 4-fast-1-slow versus 5-slow results, not new personnel classification or difficulty scoring

identity.record: object_id; claim team member_object_ids joined to current v2 record with worker, image, reference and eligibility verified
identity.team: Existing team_key, pool_id, reference_id, member_workers and member_object_ids; no new team design
identity.comparison: Existing panel_id, replicate, base_team_key, candidate_team_key; exact team pairs can repeat across replicates
identity.case: image, domain=above_peer_Q, layer=ordinary_manual, replicate; selected replicate 0, plus pa14 replicate 1 counterexample

scope.comparison_filter: n_fast=4, contrast=versus_slow; assert n=5 and origin=new; 1012 existing comparison rows across layers/domains
scope.common_domains: Intersection of allQ and above_peer_Q target image IDs separately per layer, without selecting by outcome
scope.ordinary_manual: 77 common images / 19 buildings; allQ available 142 images, above_peer_Q 77
scope.ordinary_semi: 18 allQ images / 10 buildings; no high-Q counterpart, no cross-domain mechanism claim
scope.doorway_manual: 13 allQ images / 9 buildings, 3 high-Q images / 2 buildings; 3 common images; separate descriptive records only
scope.fully_scored_sensitivity: 71 common ordinary Manual images for which all 4 draws in both domains are scored; eligibility sensitivity, not main population
scope.personnel_history: Outside target building; same condition and source; original design supports >=8 images and >=3 buildings for Q and time; Q peer gap <=3, time contrast >=1.5; not refitted here

aggregation.quality_difference: Candidate B8L2 minus base B8L2, inherited; missing remains missing; failed outcomes are not assigned zero
aggregation.D10_difference: Inherited matched 8-to-10-degree sensitivity, not a new score or changed geometry
aggregation.weights: Average member-draw rows within image/building, then image means within building, then equal building means
aggregation.failure_rates: both_scored/both_complete/base_failed/candidate_failed use same image-then-building weighting, not raw percentages
aggregation.scored_comparisons: Raw count of both_scored==true comparison rows; exact repeats are not new independent observations
aggregation.images_with_any_unscored: Count of images with at least one row not both_scored
aggregation.comparisons: Input row count for each summary; for actual_replacement_pairs this counts pair exposures rather than team comparisons
aggregation.leave_building_min/max: Range of equal-building quality means after dropping each available building once; not confidence intervals
aggregation.same_count: Inherited base/candidate fused node-count equality, not correctness or equality to reference
aggregation.source_time_ratio: exp(image/building averaged log_source_time_ratio); source reported/active labor time, not actual wall-clock delivery time
aggregation.person_pair_means: Average actual replaced pairs and member draws within image, then equal building means; not 4x more independent people or images

conditions.reference_binding: Base and candidate same reference_id, linked to reused reference_conditions.csv; selected case reference points equal current v2 evidence
conditions.H0_short: ref_H==0 and reference edge length/perimeter<0.04 with both endpoint turns>=15 degrees
conditions.H_positive: ref_H>0 under solid-polygon self-occlusion assumption; does not encode RGB/furniture visibility
conditions.unknown: Missing ref_H, not coerced to H0
conditions.short_edge: Includes narrow rectangular end walls as well as small turns; no automatic semantic necessity
conditions.effective_turns: Inherited 5-degree near-collinear exclusion; point count and effective turn count distinct
conditions.difficulty: Existing coarse label; no use of target Q to change difficulty

person_features.actual_replacement_pairs: Only history pairs with fast in candidate-minus-base and slow in base-minus-candidate; exactly 4 per panel; retained fifth slow excluded
person_features.overall_Q_gap: Historical fast-minus-slow peer-relative overall Q, inherited from selected pair table
person_features.hard_Q_mean_gap/hard_Q_peer_gap: Historical difficult-image fast-minus-slow absolute/peer-relative Q; no missing-to-zero substitution
person_features.target_Q_gap: Current v2 individual B8L2 fast-minus-slow on the target image, not a personnel-selection variable
person_features.reduced_gap: Fast-minus-slow indicator of fewer effective turns than exact declared reference
person_features.unmatched_gap: Fast-minus-slow 9-degree one-to-one bottom-ray unmatched reference fraction; not physical semantic wall identity

mechanism_outputs.selected_states.json.gz: Full unchanged native fusion state of 7 unique existing teams, preserving identity groups, observation source indices and candidate
mechanism_outputs.selected_teams.json.gz: Existing saved scores/members/IDs of those teams; not new effectiveness observations
mechanism_outputs.selected_references.json: Current exact reference points and floors for 3 mechanism pools
mechanism_outputs.selected_measurements.json: Complete native measurement dictionaries plus B8L2/D10 for selected states; diagnostics, no score replacement
mechanism_outputs.case_design.json: Four existing comparison designs: Uw22 r0, B6-48 r0, pa14 r0/r1; selection is explanatory, not prevalence estimation
mechanism_outputs.local_support.csv: All local identity groups by case/arm, votes, selected flag, workers and centers; nearest_ref_index uses horizontal proximity only, not a new semantic correspondence
mechanism_outputs.case_reference_offsets.csv: Only equal-count selected teams; one-to-one nearest cyclic horizontal reference-corner mapping for these cases, asserted unique; pixel dx/dy, camera-height corner distance, reference edge length and directed edge angle; not used for formal scores
mechanism_outputs.case_replaced_people.csv: Exactly 4 actual replaced fast/slow pairs per selected comparison design; exact repeated teams are not extra cases
mechanism_outputs.members_figures: Every line uses current processed evidence points, original pair order; no added/removed points; yellow reference, black fusion in member panels
mechanism_outputs.replay_checks.json: Native scores match saved B8L2/D10 within 1e-7 absolute tolerance; no saved full geometry existed in claim_teams, so this is not claimed as an external exact-geometry comparison

frozen_boundaries: External Pro bundle read-only; current references, scores, points, ordering, eligibility, coarse labels, fusion and scoring implementation unchanged
Manual and Semi separate; doorway separate; no cross-condition classification fitting
No new personnel labels, N1, full-team experiment rerun, public dashboard or global catalog changes
Retrospective finite-pool observations do not identify a causal effect of human working speed
No automatic inference of scope choice, RGB occlusion, semantic detail correctness or difficult-image expertise from a proxy
